purpose.summary: This is a large batch COBOL program (ORCR0030) belonging to the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It performs point/score aggregation and receipt editing by insurance category (診療区分別点数集計), processing medical claim data for Japanese health insurance billing. The program handles complex receipt layout editing, partial co-payment calculations, and various insurance-type-specific logic.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese health insurance claims processing)

verdict.notes: The file was decoded with latin-1 but the comments contain Japanese text (likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS), which appears garbled in the latin-1 rendering. This does not affect COBOL classification. The program is clearly a large, mature production component of the well-known JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system used in Japanese clinics. Dialect is most likely GnuCOBOL (formerly OpenCOBOL) given the ORCA project's known technology stack, though IBM or Micro Focus cannot be entirely ruled out without seeing compiler directives or environment entries.
